subject: TMB GitHub issues are a mess

messages.author: 402856652ba9dda3
messages.subject: TMB GitHub issues are a mess
parts:
There are a number of 'issues' that are either better suited for the TMB Users forum (e.g. #155), and/or should have been closed by now (e.g. #281, #270).  The presence of these issues makes the GitHub issues list difficult to sift through, and drastically inflates the number of apparent issues in TMB.  Fixing this would improve the public accessability of the project.

If I can, I volunteer to help with this.
